report.summary: Reviewed chunk 10 of 13 of drift.py: _remedy function and check function; claims about missing snapshot, schema, digest, and acceptance parsing are checkable; references to other functions (scan, load_snapshot, etc.) are uncheckable.
risks: check function line 1132-1143 | medium | Missing snapshot handling: when write_missing is False, returns an ok=False report but does not raise an error; may silently fail if caller expects exception. | Check if callers rely on return value vs exception.

check function line 1172-1182 | medium | Schema mismatch returns immediately but does not check digest; digest check is skipped if schema mismatched. | Verify if digest check should still be performed on mismatched schema.
check function line 1198-1210 | medium | Digest check is performed but does not stop processing; items are appended but function continues. | Confirm if this is intended to be a non-fatal warning.
todos: Review the _remedy function: all branches return strings, but there is no default for unrecognized kind (returns 'review'). Ensure callers handle this.
Check that the digest check (line 1198-1210) is intended to allow continued processing despite integrity failure.
Verify that the schema version check (line 1172-1182) is the only validation that short-circuits the function.

handoff.purpose: Contains the _remedy helper function and the check function for comparing generated state against a snapshot.

symbols.name: _remedy
symbols.note: Returns a string advice message based on the kind of drift item. Defined at line 1081 (approx). All branches return a string; final fallback returns 'review'.

symbols.name: check
symbols.note: Main comparison function. Accepts repo_root, snapshot_path, today, index, write_missing, reach_report, switch_report, probe_dirty. Returns DriftReport. May write snapshot if write_missing is True and snapshot is missing. Parses acceptances, validates schema and digest, compares old and new module/island/unknown sets (partial).

claims.text: A missing snapshot FAILS unless ``write_missing`` is set, which is the explicit "record a baseline" action rather than the default.
claims.why: Code at line 1133-1143: if snapshot is None and write_missing is False, returns DriftReport(ok=False, first_run=True, ...) indicating failure. If write_missing is True, writes snapshot and returns ok=True.

claims.text: The previous default -- write it and report OK -- meant ``rm docs/architecture-state.json`` was a green run, and a green run against nothing is exactly what this file exists to make impossible.
claims.why: This claim refers to historical behavior not present in this chunk; no code shows previous defaults.

claims.text: A missing snapshot FAILS unless ``write_missing`` is set
claims.why: See above: code returns ok=False when snapshot is None and write_missing is False.

claims.text: the mechanical lists do not match the digest written with them: something was hand-edited.
claims.why: Code compares stored_digest with recomputed digest; if mismatch, appends an INVALID_SNAPSHOT item with that detail.

claims.text: Pre-seeding an item into 'islands' or 'dark_switches' is not a way to accept it -- an acceptance is dated and an acceptance is reviewed
claims.why: The acceptance mechanism is not defined in this chunk; only referenced via parse_acceptances call at line 1167.

claims.text: stored_schema != SCHEMA_VERSION: ... the lists in a schema-{stored_schema!r} snapshot were derived by a different engine and do not mean the same thing
claims.why: Code at line 1172-1182 checks stored_schema against SCHEMA_VERSION and returns an INVALID_SNAPSHOT item with that detail.

observations.what: The _remedy function has a fallback 'review' for unrecognized kind; no validation of kind parameter.
check function uses parse_acceptances but its definition is not in this chunk; return type and error handling unknown.
After digest mismatch, items are appended but function continues; does not return early like schema mismatch.
The function compares old_modules, old_islands, old_unknown sets but does not show the comparison logic in this chunk; chunk ends before diff.
